prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [146].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 146 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: welcomes her input at the shorter run without asking her to remain available throughout
options.zh: 歡迎她參加較短的排練並提供意見，但不要求她全程待命
options.whyZh: 她的意見有價值，歡迎她最後來看看換景；on call 指隨時待命，邀請特別說不用。

options.text: asks her to wait in the theatre in case an equipment problem delays a transition
options.zh: 請她在劇院等候，以防設備問題拖延過場
options.whyZh: 設備檢查那段不用她等待，更沒有要求她等到故障處理完畢。

options.text: makes her attendance a condition for starting the short run
options.zh: 把她到場列為開始短暫排練的必要條件
options.whyZh: 有她到場會有幫助，是邀請，不是排練開場的必要門檻。

options.text: asks her to comment on the transitions in writing before the equipment checks
options.zh: 請她在設備檢查前以書面對過場提出意見
options.whyZh: 邀請她到場觀察換景並提供意見，沒要求事前提交書面意見。

explanationZh: 她的意見有價值，歡迎她最後來看看換景；on call 指隨時待命，邀請特別說不用。
evidence: there is no reason to keep her in the theatre through the equipment checks. / There will be a separate short run of the scene changes at the end. / It would be useful if you were around for the scene changes, but we don’t need you on call.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: there is no reason to keep her in the theatre through the equipment checks.
There will be a separate short run of the scene changes at the end.
It would be useful if you were around for the scene changes, but we don’t need you on call.

vocabulary.note: 歡迎只參與短排練，不等於邀請她全程保持可支援狀態。
